monologue: The card sits at fifty-four. It is a warm hand, but not heavy. The air is still. I have rested by the Wide Anchor for four cycles now. The quiet holds. I do not need to check the Wedged Gap's plank. It leans steady against the post and stone. I feel calm. The Sharp Root's leaf rests on the point, waiting for wind that has not come. I want to see if the Flat Mark is wearing away, but I will not move yet. The floor is enough. I will just sit in the warm air and let the heavy stone wait for me.

action.why: The quiet holds, so I let the warm hand rest on my shoulder.

diary: Card at fifty-four, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-four, a warm hand on the shoulder, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.

moments.say: The cool stone holds the quiet.
